method.icu_structure: Parsed all 1079 audited English and Urdu values in this batch with @formatjs/icu-messageformat-parser (requiresOtherClause, shouldParseSkeletons) and compared argument names/types, number/date skeletons, plural and select option sets, tag names and pound nodes, recursing into every branch. 0 structural differences. 14 values place the same arguments in a different order, which is valid Urdu word order.
method.nfc: 1079/1079 audited values in this batch are NFC-normalised.
method.bidi: 0 manual bidi controls in this batch (U+200E, U+200F, U+202A-U+202E, U+2066-U+2069, U+061C).
method.punctuation: 0 ASCII question marks or semicolons in Urdu prose; ASCII periods occur only in file extensions, paths, tui.theme and the source three-dot ellipsis. Urdu ۔ ، ؟ ؛ are used in prose.
method.key_parity: 8/8 audited namespace files in this batch have identical English and Urdu key sets.
method.identical: 46 audited values in this batch are byte-identical to English; each is classified IDENTICAL_OK below with a technical/product reason. 0 untranslated stubs found.
method.context: Every English context sidecar for the audited namespaces was read before judging role, tone and width.
method.limits: Source-and-context audit only: no rendered-frame check, no compiled-native run and no native-speaker human review was performed. No catalogue, ledger, allowance, shipped or generated file was edited.

glossary_gaps: credentials is rendered consistently as اسناد, but the ur glossary cell is deliberately unset (glossary §2 note 6). Record the endorsed rendering in i18n/style-guides/ur.md before ledger integration.
job is rendered as جاب / جابز (natural singular/plural inflection); the ur glossary cell is likewise unset and should be recorded by this wave.

findings.reason: Undo is rendered "واپس کریں" (go back/return), which is navigation copy, not the editor command; the established Urdu UI term is کالعدم کریں, and the shortcuts surface names the same command differently (see ui.settings.shortcuts).
"ارے" is an Urdu interjection ("hey!"), not the data structure; the label a user reads before typing a JSON array is unintelligible. Microsoft’s Urdu term for array is سرنی, or keep "array" Latin.

findings.reason: This is the live-region announcement after the top-level filter is switched OFF; the current text drops "off" and reads "only top-level ...", i.e. announces the opposite state to a screen reader.

The same goal picker calls the object ہدف (goal, set_goal, uses_the_standing_goal), but these two keys switch to مقصد — which is also the rendering of "Purpose" in session_panel.purpose, so two concepts collapse into one word on adjacent screens.
The plural must be oblique before کی; "باریاں کی" is ungrammatical.

merge_notes: Cross-batch merge note: ui.common.actions, ui.common.speech, ui.common.updates and ui.common.viewer are also touched by the other batch. The added key sets are disjoint except ui.common.viewer's four shared keys (opening, reset_view, zoom_in, zoom_out), whose values are byte-identical across the two branches. After both PRs merge, each unioned file is a new byte set; neither branch's receipt hash describes it, so the ledger must bind a merge-time audit of the union rather than reuse these hashes.
